en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey institutional building complex in a wooded area, likely a sanatorium or hospital. There is open grass in the foreground with simple wooden play structures or frames, and tall conifer trees around the site. The buildings have steep roofs and multiple rows of windows, in a Northern European architectural style. A white border surrounds the image and small printed captions appear at the lower edge.
